sql: select created_at, (details->>'skipped_contest_cap') as skip_contest, (details->>'skipped_event_rung_cap') as skip_rung, (details->>'opened') as opened, (details->'per_book'->>'Gmmsell0') as g0, (details->'per_book'->>'Gmmsell1') as g1 from system_events where component='mmsell_scan' and created_at > now() - interval '90 minutes' order by created_at desc limit 12
